Maybe this lecture and stoic ideals will help you if you are in times of despair and sadness the way this lecture and those ideals helped me.

comments.author: apienx
comments.why: A classic lecture on Marcus Aurelius
comments.text: “Freedom is the only worthy goal in life. It is won by disregarding things that lie beyond our control." -- Epictetus In 2023, I think we can achieve a level of control that's incomprehensible to Epictetus. The goal is to maximize equanimity, freedom, and control over one's time/destiny. Money can get you quite far on that path. I sometimes feel that Massimo's just bitter at the success of people like Ryan Holiday (who just took Massimo's work and "packaged" it). P.S.
